description: This Java class 'WidgetContentWorker' provides a singleton-like static accessor for the ContentWorkerInterface, dynamically loading an implementation class at runtime. It serves as a utility within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.content' package to facilitate access to content-related functionalities.

classes.name: WidgetContentWorker
classes.description: A utility class that lazily loads and provides access to an implementation of ContentWorkerInterface.

methods.name: getContentWorker
methods.description: Returns the singleton ContentWorkerInterface instance loaded at class initialization.
